hooks.statusMessage: After-code rule: building & checking commit state…
hooks.command: input=$(cat); dirty=$(git status --porcelain -- src functions 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$dirty" ]; then exit 0; fi; if npm run build:vite >/tmp/mango-stop-build.log 2>&1; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"✅ build passes — remember to commit the change and update docs if necessary (project rule).","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"Stop","additionalContext":"Uncommitted changes exist under src/ or functions/ and npm run build:vite passes. Per the project after-code rule: make a clean, scoped commit and update docs if necessary before finishing, unless the user asked you to hold."}}'; else printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Project after-code rule: files under src/ or functions/ changed but `npm run build:vite` failed. Run it, fix the errors, then finish — and commit + update docs once it is green."}'; fi
